name: Multidimensional Scaling (MDS)
when_to_use: (Dis)similarity matrix between items; represent the items on a low-dimensional map preserving the perceived relative distances.
notes: Turns a table of "how similar two items are" into a visual map where similar items sit close together. Applications: positioning map of competing brands from consumer perception.

expected_input.question: How to visualize, in a few dimensions, how similar or different the items are?

plain_explanation.purpose: Draws items on a map where distance on paper reflects similarity distance.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you have similarities or distances between items and want to visualize them.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table of distances/similarities between items, or numeric columns to compute them.
plain_explanation.example: Brand map according to customer perception.
plain_explanation.diagram: distance table -> 2D map: similar items sit close
